<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.64.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* [feature] Add `on_change="ignore"` mode to st.number_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16649
* [fix] Support asyncio.get_event_loop() in scripts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16167
* [feature] Add live parameter to st.text_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16662
* [feature] Add st.echarts_chart for native Apache ECharts support by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16785
* [feature] Async-aware st.cache_data and st.cache_resource by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16168
* [feature] Add `on_change="ignore"` mode to st.select_slider by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16776
* [feature] Add `on_change="ignore"` mode to st.selectbox by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16862
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Keep widget values after body-level st.rerun by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16762
* [fix] Remove expired mapbox.token config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16774
* [fix] Delay button help tooltips on hover by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16794
* [fix] Prevent duplicate Altair bind widgets with on_select by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16809
* [fix] Theme Altair parameter-binding widgets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16813
* [fix] Register deck.gl layer extensions in pydeck by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16823
* [fix] Honor pydeck views in st.pydeck_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16819
* [fix] Encode download filenames unsafe in a quoted header by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16646
* [fix] Skip no-op query-param history entries by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16831
* [fix] Expose st.radio captions as option descriptions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16811
* [fix] Parse unknown AppTest proto subtypes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16835
* [fix] Raise AppTestError for unsupported AppTest interactions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16837
* [fix] Increase Vega-Lite legend title padding by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16818
* [fix] Stop dropping in-flight Custom Components v2 triggers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16833
* [fix] Stringify list columns PyArrow cannot serialize by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16838
* [fix] Keep elements stale while a stop is pending by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16839
* [fix] Install skills where Claude Code will find them by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16394
* [fix] Preserve empty AppTest chat input and ChatInputValue repr by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16857
* [fix] Reject async cache_resource lifecycle callbacks by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16860
* [fix] Render Altair mark_geoshape charts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16886
* [fix] Hide Streamlit internals from UI traces by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16718
* [fix] Swap reversed st.slider min/max bounds by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16716
* [fix] Reject inverted st.number_input min/max bounds by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16895
* [fix] Improve nested url_path error message by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16896
* [fix] Add dict methods to AppTest.session_state by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16897
* [fix] Close leftover dialogs on full-app rerun by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16901
* [fix] Classify invalid icon= values more precisely by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16900
* [fix] Add AppTest proto-variant parse smoke tests by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16911
* [fix] Reject unsupported on_change modes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16889
* [fix] Prevent callback rerun coalescing races by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16765
### Other Changes
* [chore] Release v1.63.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16764
* [docs] Fix chartCategoricalColors and Graphviz docs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16815
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16753
* Bump plotly.js from 3.7.0 to 4.0.0 in /frontend in the plotly group across 1 directory by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16740
* [docs] Discourage custom HTML in markdown docs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16830
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16867


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.63.0...1.64.0
